default.description: Plain, accessible page layout: page title heading followed by the freeform body. Applied automatically when create_page is called without an explicit template.

module_outcomes.description: Module Outcomes page: a short intro and an ordered list of what students will be able to do by the end of the module.
module_outcomes.html:
{{title}}

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

    {{slot:outcomes}}

outcomes.description: Ordered-list items (<li>) listing what students will be able to do by the end of the module. Each <li> is one observable outcome starting with an action verb (Design, Build, Evaluate, Analyze, Apply, Troubleshoot, Demonstrate...). Align to industry/CTE standards or competencies where the teacher names them. 4-8 items is typical.

lesson.description: Lesson page: what students learn about and learn to do, then Key Concepts, Resources, Class Tasks, and optional Discussion and Related Assessment sections.
lesson.html:
{{title}}

In this lesson you will learn about

{{slot:about}}

In this lesson you will learn to

{{slot:to}}

Key Concepts and Terms

{{slot:concepts}}

Lesson Resources

{{slot:resources}}

Class Tasks

{{slot:tasks}}

Discussion

{{slot:discussion}}

Related Assessment

{{slot:assessment}}

about.description: What students will learn about (the topic / content). 1-2 sentence summary.

to.description: What skills students will gain: a short bulleted list of can-do statements.

concepts.description: Key concepts and terms with brief definitions.

resources.description: Links to readings, videos, websites, tools, or other materials referenced in the lesson.

tasks.description: Tasks for students to complete during the lesson (include safety notes for lab/shop activities where relevant).

discussion.description: Discussion forum link or prompt. Only used when a discussion is part of the lesson.

assessment.description: Link to a related assessment task (when there is one).

discussion.description: Discussion section. Off by default. Pass include_sections: ['discussion'] when the teacher mentions a discussion or debate.

assessment.description: Related-assessment section. On by default. Pass omit_sections: ['assessment'] for purely formative lessons.
Assessment page with six blocks: Description, Pre-Work, Structure and Grading (with grade boundaries table), Submission, Time, and Use of AI.
assessment.html:
{{title}}

Assessment Description

{{slot:description}}

Pre-Work

{{slot:pre_work}}

Structure and Grading

{{slot:structure_and_grading}}

Submission

{{slot:submission}}

Time

{{slot:time}}

Use of Artificial Intelligence

{{slot:ai_use}}

description.description: What the assessment is: an intro paragraph followed by a numbered or bulleted list of what students will do.

pre_work.description: What students should have completed BEFORE the assessment: a short paragraph plus a numbered list of prerequisites.

structure_and_grading.description: Three things in one block: (1) what students should expect (number of questions, points, deliverables), (2) grade weighting (what share of the grading period this is worth, if the teacher says), and (3) a grade boundaries <table> with a header row mapping letter grades (A through F, or the teacher's scale) to point ranges.

submission.description: How students submit their work (in class, upload to Canvas, demonstration, etc.).

time.description: Time allotment, including extended-time accommodations if relevant. For long-term projects, a timeline.

ai_use.description: Acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI for this assessment, as two bulleted lists. Be explicit and assessment-specific.
